english.note: 手頭上有 means to have on hand.

exampleSentences.english: Right. There were different translations even into the twentieth century. I have a few myself.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係嘞。噉，誒，同埋到二十世紀都有不同嘅譯本囖。我自己手頭上都有幾個譯本，喀。
